summary: Flyway V3 adds the nullable link.note VARCHAR(280); no default, so PostgreSQL changes only the catalog and the previous version keeps working.

files.newContent:
-- An optional note the owner keeps with a link (plain text, at most 280 characters).
-- Nullable without a default: a catalog-only change in PostgreSQL, so the table isn't rewritten and
-- the previous version of the service keeps working against this schema.
ALTER TABLE link ADD COLUMN note VARCHAR(280);
